name: occlubio-ios
description: iOS/iPadOS shell for the occlubio console. The UI and processing stay on the occlubio server.

scripts.sync: npm run config && cap sync ios
scripts.build:sim: npm run sync && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
